fields.title: Library writes: the renderer-side and policy follow-ups
fields.description: Split from LIBRARY-WRITE-RACE-1. Covers `save-library` id de-duplication, malformed-element tests and type checks; the Edit form's fire-and-forget save, whose failure UX is an owner decision; renderer edits not bumping `modified` (a Brain sync ruling); and the cloud sync's `setLibrary` (deferred Cloud lane).
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-22 by Blurby.Roadmap when LIBRARY-WRITE-RACE-1 was specified. Stub; needs an owner decision (Edit-form failure UX) and a Brain ruling (modified bump). Not a release gate.
